decisionSummary: The current v0.1.6 dev-publish tip is the newest valid forward ClientSpace source. It merges the recent bounded reporting-session, durable sturdyref persistence, log-redaction, and session-lifecycle work, then binds the forward package metadata to a byte-identical double pack. The current main tip is its reviewed ancestor. Every preserved, salvage, and historic publish ref was inventoried; their unique historical package evidence or superseded security work is not a newer application source than the tested merge.
